title: Going home to Social Circle and Higgy Comes Home
summary: After the sessions he visited his sister near Social Circle; the record included his singing of St. James Infirmary.

blocks.x: After you did the record in Atlanta and you came to New York and you went back down to Atlanta to work on a steady job. Where was the place you were working in Atlanta on a steady job?
After I finished in Atlanta I went back to Social Circle.
Went back to the farm. Stayed down at my sister's about 8 days, right out in the country.
That was in 1966? What sister was this?
When did Sweetie die, Annie May? About 4 years ago. It was in the Fall. That's when he went back for his sister's funeral... He made 'Higgy Comes Home'.

After he finished making it, he came back to New York, right? Then you went back to Atlanta to work a steady job? Oh, for his sister's funeral, O.K., fine. Now, when you put together that record, 'Higgy Comes Home', you and Bud Freeman flew down from New York.
We did that. Bud came back -
Was that a lot of fun doing that record?
That was around Christmas time because on the record you recorded 'Jingle Bells' also.
It was before then because we did the same tune I played in the Newport Festival, 'St. James Infirmary'.
Was that you singing St. James Infirmary?
Did you do much singing in your career.
